trail_axis_exit.descriptive_fact: The recorded held-out trail-axis treatment contrasts vary strongly in magnitude and include zero and negative values. This is a property of the already-frozen development report, not a new target analysis.

conclusions_allowed: P1-v1 failed its preregistered robustness requirement despite a positive median relative improvement.
The recorded held-out treatment-response surface is heterogeneous across colonies and paths.
A single shared always-engaged deterministic attractive P1 response did not generalize sufficiently under the frozen test.
The official result does not identify why generalization failed.
conclusions_forbidden: Colony 27 is an outlier that may be removed or downweighted.

transient within-individual response lapses or behavioral noise

next_gate: An independently grounded P2 evidence gate may compare plausible mechanism classes, but it must not use the P1 failure pattern to tune a replacement mechanism or reopen P1-v1.
